text: Output is structured as an IA review with sections covering structure issues, navigation gaps, and labeling problems
Identifies advanced/index.md as an orphan with no inbound navigation path, and the pages under it as unreachable through navigation
Proposes concrete renames for the opaque labels: stuff/, notes.md, old.md, tmp-2.md, and misc.md, using names a reader can predict content from
Connects the top three support tickets to the buried content (webhook verification in tmp-2.md, rate limits inside misc.md, v1 migration in old.md) and promotes those to findable locations
Splits misc.md, since rate limits, SLAs, and deprecation policy are unrelated topics grouped by nothing
Addresses whether file names and headings match the words users actually search for, not only where files sit
Labeling fixes are given as concrete current-to-proposed pairs, not vague advice to use better names
Output includes a concrete target file or directory tree
